channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Yemen gov’t accuses IRGC, Hezbollah of sending 21 experts to back Houthis
item.description: Yemeni interior minister says foreign involvement expanded beyond arms and training to directing military operations.

item.title: Russian strikes on Dnipro kill two, injure 20 others
item.description: Russian strikes on Dnipro damaged residential areas and several medical facilities.

item.title: Darfur survivors vow to tell story of those killed after Sudan camp attacks
item.description: Survivors of attacks on displacement camps in Darfur recall the lives they built, and violence that forced them to flee.

item.title: Opposition party organiser killed before South Africa elections
item.description: Police are investigating the motive in murder of MKP coordinator as political killings rise during municipal elections.

item.title: Syria says it foiled Hezbollah plot to target Homs oil refinery
item.description: Hezbollah denies the Syrian accusations, reiterating that it does not have any presence on Syrian territory.

item.title: Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash
item.description: At least 69 people were killed and dozens injured in the collision south of the capital, Madrid.

item.title: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital
item.description: At least 38 people are killed in 24 hours and Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky warns dozens more could be trapped under rubble.

item.title: US strikes Iranian island ahead of midterm elections
item.description: US officials described the attacks on Qeshm Island as limited and defensive, according to CBS, the BBC's US partner.

item.title: Indian tourist killed after two helicopters collide near Everest base camp
item.description: The two aircraft crashed just metres from the ground after trying to land at the same spot.

item.title: 'I couldn't be silent': Iranian teen's mother seeking justice after daughter shot dead
item.description: BBC Panorama follows grieving Samira who - after the killing of Sevda - faces up to the Tehran regime.
